lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in quasi-vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The mid-flank region exhibits a primary grid of approximately four to five major nodes per column, with smaller, more numerous clusters appearing more dorsally.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased pixel intensity are visible, aligning with the vertical columns of spots to create a characteristic grid-like structural pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with high-intensity pixels on the upper surface and a distinct shadow region directly below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The macro-mask of the first dorsal fin contains approximately eight distinct high-luminance blobs, distributed primarily in the anterior and central regions of the fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large, irregular high-luminance patch is visible on the upper flank near the posterior base of the first dorsal fin, consistent with a healed dermal abrasion or scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense, high-frequency spotting is visible on the leading edge and distal tip of the primary pectoral fin.
